gate.why: These checks address inconsistent branding, noncanonical version names, and omitted qualifiers that distinguish complete versions.
lines: Resolve conflicting brand fields using the model’s identity in the target Mexican taxonomy before rejecting a listing.
Match versions to the target make–model–year taxonomy, applying established aliases for trim, engine, drivetrain, and transmission.
Retain all explicit version qualifiers across title, model, and version fields, including body style, cab configuration, and “Estándar.”
